description: Dear Earth Postcards is Gregorio Guirado, from São Paulo, Brazil: a 3D animation and visual effects artist with clients in 9 countries. He was VFX supervisor on the animated feature My Grandfather Is a Nihonjin (Annecy), where 3D shadow gives each 2D shot its time of day, and presented an automated Blender pipeline at Blender Conference 2025. Dear Earth follows the same ideas: the real Sun is the light, and one row of NASA data makes one postcard. Solo team, not recruiting.
